other_conditions: Applicant must be a member of a registered fisheries cooperative society
Cooperative society should be actively involved in fisheries activities
Water body must be a stable water resource such as a reservoir, check dam, coal pit, or similar areas affected by mining
Water body should have a minimum size to qualify for stocking and development
benefits_summary: Provides fish fingerlings, subsidies on nets and boats, and supports cage culture to boost fish production and livelihoods of cooperative society members.
